title: Protective Helmets for Riders of Two-Wheeled Motor Vehicles — Specification (Fourth Revision)
scope: This standard lays down requirements for materials, construction, workmanship, finish and performance for protective helmets for riders of two-wheeled motor vehicles.
qco_reference: Helmets for Riders of Two-Wheelers (Quality Control) Order, 2021 (S.O. 4252(E))

clauses.title: Impact Absorption
clauses.content: The helmet shall not transmit an acceleration exceeding 300 gn to the headform during guided drop impact tests.

clauses.title: Retention System
clauses.content: The chin strap dynamic displacement shall not exceed 35 mm under a 1.0 kN tensile force.

clauses.title: Visor Optical Characteristics
clauses.content: Luminous transmittance of clear visors shall not be less than 85 percent.
